mains.label: Mains power
mains.technical: Utility feed. Everything without a UPS behind it stops when it fails.

ups.label: UPS
ups.simple: A battery that keeps the network running through short power cuts.
ups.technical: Online UPS with network card; bridges short outages and reports battery state by SNMP.

clinic-firewall.label: Firewall / router
clinic-firewall.simple: The clinic's door to the internet and to headquarters.
clinic-firewall.technical: Cloud-managed firewall: two WAN links with failover, IPsec to HQ, inter-VLAN rules, DHCP and DNS resolver for the site.

hq-firewall.label: Firewall (HA pair)
hq-firewall.simple: Protects headquarters. A second unit takes over if one fails.
hq-firewall.technical: Active/passive pair with a shared virtual IP. VPN hub for all clinics, two ISPs with automatic failover.

access-switch.label: Switch
access-switch.simple: Connects all wired devices and powers Wi-Fi and phones.
access-switch.technical: 24-port PoE access switch. Access ports per VLAN, trunk to the firewall.

core-switch.label: Core switch
core-switch.simple: The central junction of headquarters. There are two, so one can fail.
core-switch.technical: MLAG pair. Every host and firewall is connected to both switches.

access-point.label: Wi-Fi access point
access-point.simple: Provides Wi-Fi for staff and guests.
access-point.technical: Wi-Fi 6 AP, PoE powered. SSIDs: staff (VLAN 20), guest (VLAN 100, client isolation).

esxi-host.label: ESXi host
esxi-host.simple: A physical server that runs several virtual servers at once.
esxi-host.technical: One of three hosts in the vSphere cluster. HA and DRS enabled, one host of capacity reserved (N+1).

storage-controller.label: Storage controller
storage-controller.simple: Half of the shared disk system. The other half takes over if it fails.
storage-controller.technical: One of two controllers of the shared array. Each host reaches both over two paths (multipathing).

backup-storage.label: Backup storage
backup-storage.simple: Keeps copies of all important data.
backup-storage.technical: On-site backup repository. Second copy of the 3-2-1 rule; the third is offsite and immutable.

reception-mac.label: Reception Mac
reception-mac.simple: Appointments, patient files and invoices at the front desk.
reception-mac.technical: Mac mini, wired, VLAN 20. MDM-managed, FileVault on. Uses the cloud practice software and the file server.

treatment-mac.label: Treatment room Mac
treatment-mac.simple: The vet's computer for patient files and X-ray images.
treatment-mac.technical: MacBook Air on staff Wi-Fi, VLAN 20. Roams between access points.

admin-mac.label: IT admin Mac
admin-mac.technical: MacBook Pro. Admin tasks run through the jump host with a separate admin account and MFA.

card-terminal.label: Card terminal
card-terminal.technical: Alone in VLAN 40. May only reach the payment provider over HTTPS, nothing inside the clinic.

receipt-printer.label: Receipt printer
receipt-printer.technical: Network receipt printer, VLAN 50, static address. Printed from the reception Mac.

label-printer.label: Label printer
label-printer.simple: Prints labels for medication and lab samples.
label-printer.technical: Network label printer, VLAN 50, static address.

document-printer.label: Printer / scanner
document-printer.technical: Multifunction printer, VLAN 50, static address. Scans go to a share on the file server.

voip-phone.label: Phone
voip-phone.technical: IP phone, PoE powered, VLAN 60. Registers with the cloud telephone system.

xray-pc.label: X-ray workstation
xray-pc.simple: Takes X-ray images and sends them to the central archive.
xray-pc.technical: Acquisition PC, VLAN 30, static address. Sends DICOM to the PACS at HQ through the VPN. No internet.

lab-analyzer.label: Lab analyzer
lab-analyzer.simple: Analyses blood samples in the clinic.
lab-analyzer.technical: In-house analyzer, VLAN 30. Sends results to the lab interface server at HQ.

ultrasound.label: Ultrasound
ultrasound.simple: Ultrasound device in the treatment room.
ultrasound.technical: VLAN 30, static address. Stores images in the PACS by DICOM.

guest-client.label: Guest devices
guest-client.simple: Phones of pet owners in the waiting room.
guest-client.technical: Guest Wi-Fi, VLAN 100. Internet only, clients cannot see each other.

vm-vcenter.label: vCenter
vm-vcenter.simple: The control centre for the virtual servers.
vm-vcenter.technical: Manages the cluster. DRS and vMotion need it; HA restarts work without it.

vm-identity.label: Identity / DNS server
vm-identity.simple: Knows all users and passwords. There are two.
vm-identity.technical: Directory and internal DNS. Two VMs with an anti-affinity rule: never on the same host.

vm-pacs.label: Image archive (PACS)
vm-pacs.simple: Central archive for X-ray and ultrasound images.
vm-pacs.technical: PACS server, receives DICOM from all clinics. Viewer over HTTPS for the vets.

vm-files.label: File server
vm-files.technical: SMB shares with role-based permissions. Reached through the VPN.

vm-lab.label: Lab interface server
vm-lab.simple: Passes lab results on to the practice software.
vm-lab.technical: Receives results from the analyzers and forwards them to the practice management app.

vm-jump.label: Jump host
vm-jump.simple: The only door for administrators and device vendors.
vm-jump.technical: All admin and vendor remote access goes through it: MFA, time-limited, logged.

vm-monitoring.label: Monitoring
vm-monitoring.simple: Watches all devices and raises the alarm early.
vm-monitoring.technical: Polls SNMP, pings and service checks at every site. Sends alerts to on-call.

vm-automation.label: Automation host
vm-automation.simple: Applies the same settings to all clinics automatically.
vm-automation.technical: Runs Ansible and keeps configuration backups in Git.

vm-backup.label: Backup server
vm-backup.simple: Makes the backups every night and tests them.
vm-backup.technical: Backs up all VMs to the repository and copies them offsite. Restore tests are scheduled.

isp.label: Internet provider
isp.simple: The company that delivers the internet line.
isp.technical: Business line with static IP and SLA.

mobile-network.label: LTE/5G backup
mobile-network.simple: Mobile internet that steps in when the main line fails.
mobile-network.technical: Failover uplink over a mobile network. Behind carrier NAT, so the clinic always starts the tunnel.

payment-provider.label: Payment provider
payment-provider.simple: The bank service behind the card terminal.
payment-provider.technical: Payment gateway, reached over HTTPS from VLAN 40 only.

voip-provider.label: Cloud telephone system
voip-provider.simple: The telephone service on the internet.
voip-provider.technical: Hosted PBX. Phones register over SIP-TLS and SRTP.

vendor-support.label: Device vendor support
vendor-support.simple: Remote support from the makers of the medical devices.
vendor-support.technical: Inbound only through the jump host, on request and time-limited. Never directly into VLAN 30.

cloud-lb.label: Load balancer
cloud-lb.simple: Spreads the load over several servers of the practice software.
cloud-lb.technical: Public endpoint of the practice management app. Health checks, TLS termination.

cloud-app.label: Practice management app
cloud-app.simple: The software for appointments, patient files and invoices.
cloud-app.technical: Runs in a public cloud in the EU. Access through IAM roles with least privilege.

saas-mdm.label: Mac management (MDM)
saas-mdm.technical: Cloud MDM. New Macs enrol by themselves on first start (zero-touch).

saas-netmgmt.label: Network management
saas-netmgmt.simple: The dashboard for all firewalls, switches and access points.
saas-netmgmt.technical: Cloud management of the network devices: templates, firmware, status.

cloud-storage.label: Offsite backup
cloud-storage.simple: A backup copy outside the building that nobody can change.
cloud-storage.technical: Immutable object storage in the EU. Third copy of the 3-2-1 rule.
